info.title: EC Market API — proposed v1
info.description: Contract-first draft. x-implementation-status identifies real endpoints. Legacy MVC remains supported. Completed is the current recognized revenue status; this is not a payment gateway confirmation. Categories now use parentId instead of kind (breaking change). Product/order kind remains an independent discriminator.
